title: Ultrasound characteristics of follicular and parafollicular thyroid neoplasms: diagnostic performance of artificial neural network
summary: Specific histology-linked sonographic differences and ANN discrimination evaluated against pathological diagnoses constitute a defined diagnostic result. Accuracy varies widely; established clinical readiness is not established. The result is limited to this study and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.ai_role: institutional retrospective cohort, 148 thyroidectomy patients (37 each medullary, papillary, follicular carcinoma and follicular adenoma); seven demographic/morphologic features input to 3-layer ANN; leave-one-out CV plus 75/20/5 split. Contour/structure/calcification differ by pathology; pairwise ANN accuracy 0.59–0.98 (wide CI). Histology is reference; small balanced sample and retrospective design limit clinical generalization.
